prs.title: docs: add PWM MAD 4x08 parameter variant
prs.author: vector-arrow
prs.excerpt:
Temporary/reference parameter file for a Quiver setup using MAD 4x08 FOC motors over PWM instead of CAN ESC output.

Changes from standard params:
- disables UAVCAN/DroneCAN ESC motor bitmap with `CAN_D1_UC_ESC_BM,0`
- switches motor output to normal PWM with `MOT_PWM_TYPE,0`
